pagetitle: 'Join us!'

If you share our vision and would like to contribute to better research and a positive research culture, then feel free to contact us and become a contributor of the MERRI Collaboration. 

Find our definition of contribution in our Terms of Reference. Fill in the [following form](https://forms.gle/4TV2nrsmDSX7QTZk9){.external target="_blank"} to let us know that you are interested in joining us. 


For any questions, make sure to contact us via [merricollaboration@gmail.com](mailto:merricollaboration@gmail.com).

## Internal Communincation

MERRI uses Zulip for our internal group communication. [Zulip](https://zulip.com/){.external target="_blank"} is an organized team chat app designed for efficient communication. We are grateful to Zulip for supporting MERRI by sponsoring our Cloud account. 

![](images/zulip-icon-128x128.png){width=64px}

Once you have joined us by filling out the form above, you will receive a link to the MERRI Zulip group.
